mei: Quick follow-up on canary failover semantics. We've seen sticky session tail keep old variant alive; thinking a minimal "eviction handshake" protocol between controller -> router would help.

jon: Sounds useful. What does handshake contain?

mei: Decision envelope: decision_id, tenant, action (PASS|REHOME|EVICT_PROB|EVICT_NOW), drain_until, fraction (for prob eviction), ttl_secs, signer, api_version, reason. Router uses this to decide new binds only; never kills active streams.

reza: +1. Important: probabilistic eviction needs stable RNG per-tenant so behavior is reproducible. Use seed = hash(decision_id + router_id).

ops-bot: alert: canary-7 p95 spike @5777771240

jon: Hysteresis idea: require min_probes OR confidence > threshold to escalate to EVICT_NOW. Manual overrides skip checks.

mei: Also include compatibility_label per-variant so router avoids mixing incompatible caches. If labels mismatch, router logs and refuses to rehome until operator confirms.

reza: Offline resilience: router caches signed decision until ttl; if ttl expired, fall back to controller behavior and emit rollout_decision_miss metric. Add kill-switch: if mismatch_rate > 1% over 5m, router ignores arbiter and falls back to controller with paging.

jon: Ops playbook snippets please: how to find stuck binds?

mei: Run: `rb-list-binds --tenant t-XXX --variant old` then correlate traces with decision_id header. If > threshold, issue higher fraction EVICT_PROB or schedule maintenance.

deploy-bot: :rocket: scheduled r-3002 cohort=canary @5777771250

reza: I'll draft minimal RFC w/ envelope proto, RNG seeding, TTL rules, metrics to emit, and migration checklist. Will post to #eng-platform.

mei: Thanks — keep it opt-in initially. Let's mirror decisions to controller for 48h and diff before flipping tenants.

jon: :thumbsup:
